# Branding and corporate issues

| Problem | Answer! |
| --- | --- |
| **What company is Kuailu Technology?** | Kuailu Technology (KUAILUTECH) is an AI technology-driven enterprise that provides integrated, intelligent office capacity that covers the main business premises. The specific brand location, subject and scope of operations are based on the “brand profile” knowledge point. |
| ** Where is Kuailu Technology headquarters? What is the location? How many offices?** | The headquarters is located on the 61st-65th floor of the Fukuda Preservative Area, Fukuda, Shenzhen City, on the fifth floor of CFC, the long-run Rich Mok Building. Six regional centres operate in Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Hong Kong, China, and Singapore, and operate networks that are radioactive to South-East Asian markets such as Malaysia, Thailand, Viet Nam, Indonesia and the Philippines; specific office entities and services are based on the latest official information on Kuailu Technology. |
| ** What is Kuailu Technology ' s business concept and vision for development?** | The corporate concept is intelligent, integrated and globalized; the vision is to build an AI office engine for global businesses. |
| ** How to contact Kuailu Technology** | Hotline: 400-0881-183; Business Mailbox: sales@kuailutech.com; also via Kuailu Technology official public or video number. |
| ** How long has Kuailu Technology been in existence? What size? ** | Branding or team development began in April 2020; Shenzhen Kuailu Technology Limited was established in April 2022. |
| ** How well does Kuailu Technology develop? How many employees?** | Kuailu currently has over 500 professional teams, with over 70 per cent R & D personnel, and over 10 per cent AI algorithms. |
| ** What are Kuailu Technology's qualifications and intellectual property rights?** | As of August 2026, there were 26 cumulative software copyrights, 15 qualifications and 7 invention patents. Specific qualifications, subject matter, time of acquisition and period of validity are determined by the point of knowledge of the corresponding certificate. |
| ** How many clients do Kuailu Technology currently serve? Areas covered** | Global partnership client 1000+. Six regional centres operate in Shenzhen, Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Hong Kong, China, and Singapore, and operate networks that are irradiated in South-East Asian markets such as Malaysia, Thailand, Viet Nam, Indonesia and the Philippines. |
| ** What award did Kuailu Technology receive?** | The award related to GAIE was recorded in the STIF Festival of Innovative Applications of the International Section; the full title of the award was based on the award certificate or the host material. |
| ** What is Kuailu Technology's target client image?** | MSMEs, commercial and service enterprises and other business enterprises are mainly oriented towards the need for digital transformation, system integration and cross-sectoral synergies; their suitability depends on the business landscape, product modules and implementation conditions. |
